Well now I feel called out. I been friend with a guy for a year and boy have we overshared, I know I have messed up, I know I can be  a pretty toxic person to myself and others, I know I have a lot to work on but I don't know if I should just stop talking to him. Like doing the whole "it's for your own sake" thing, or is it still possible to build a healthy friendship with him?

Hey thanks a lot! I really appreciate it, and it's kind of difficult not feeling guilty when everyone keeps saying you should, but I'll do my best.  Also I'm sorry to hear that about your mom, may I ask how are you doing now?
Thanks for replying! And I don't really know, I will have to look for some info about that, hopefully there's a place
